strings: m_c rolls over in the nest, purposely turning away from where the sun streaks into the den. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} can't stand the way it makes {PRONOUN/m_c/object} wince.
It feels like a kitten has been playing mossball right on top of m_c's head, pounding away while all {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can do is mope.
m_c dully looks at r_c0, while the fever saps {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} strength more {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head also echoes with a dull throb. Just more issues compounding one another.
